title: beach/ocean in my dreams
content: I had commented on someone’s post on here the other day because they mentioned a coastal town. I’ve also had a coastal town in my dreams. I know this isn’t really part of mall world, but these dreams give me the same feeling. Usually I’m staying in a hotel or condo right by the beach. Like I said in my reply, the coast is nothing like the beaches I’ve been to in real life (I’ve only been to FL beaches). These photos are the closest thing I can find that look similar. The beach itself is quite small and short. There’s pools of shallow water like in the first picture, but I don’t believe they’re manmade like that. Then there’s giant cliffs and the water gets very deep!! I always seem to see someone I know when I go down to the water. In a recent dream like this, I was on a big boat with three levels, and it was in a cove type area with deep water. I fell off the top level somehow into the water, and it felt so real! I remember feeling deep under the water and trying to get back up for air fast. Also there’s huge, terrifying waves sometimes. Anyone else have a coastal area they visit?
